tutors.name: Sarah O’Donnell
tutors.subject: English
tutors.title: English Tutor – Sarah O’Donnell
tutors.bio: Sarah O’Donnell is a highly experienced English tutor with over ten years of teaching both Higher and Ordinary Level students. She specialises in exam‑focused preparation, helping students build confidence in comprehension, composition, and comparative study. Sarah is known for her supportive teaching style and her ability to break down complex texts into clear, manageable ideas.

tutors.name: Dr. Liam Murphy
tutors.subject: Biology
tutors.title: Biology Tutor – Dr. Liam Murphy
tutors.bio: Dr. Liam Murphy brings a strong scientific background to his Biology grinds, having completed a PhD in Molecular Biology. His classes focus on understanding rather than memorisation, with particular emphasis on genetics, ecology, and human physiology. Liam’s calm, structured approach helps students master lab‑based questions and long‑answer formats.

tutors.name: Aoife Byrne
tutors.subject: Maths
tutors.title: Maths Tutor – Aoife Byrne
tutors.bio: Aoife Byrne is a dedicated Mathematics tutor who has worked with Leaving Certificate students for more than eight years. She focuses on building problem‑solving skills through clear explanations and step‑by‑step methods. Aoife is especially effective with students who struggle with confidence, helping them turn weaknesses into strengths.

tutors.name: Mark Gallagher
tutors.subject: Geography
tutors.title: Geography Tutor – Mark Gallagher
tutors.bio: Mark Gallagher has a passion for Geography and brings real‑world examples into every lesson. His teaching style blends visual learning with practical exam strategies, making topics like geomorphology and population studies easier to understand. Mark is known for his engaging classes and his ability to simplify difficult concepts.

tutors.name: Emma Walsh
tutors.subject: Business
tutors.title: Business Tutor – Emma Walsh
tutors.bio: Emma Walsh has extensive experience teaching Business, Accounting, and Economics at both school and grind levels. She focuses on exam‑ready techniques, ensuring students understand key definitions, case studies, and financial reasoning. Emma’s lessons are structured, clear, and highly effective for students aiming for top grades.

tutors.name: Niamh Keane
tutors.subject: Art
tutors.title: Art Tutor – Niamh Keane
tutors.bio: Niamh Keane is a practising artist and experienced Art teacher who supports students in both practical and written components of the exam. She helps students develop strong portfolios while also preparing them for art history and appreciation. Niamh’s classes encourage creativity while staying aligned with exam requirements.

tutors.name: Patrick Doyle
tutors.subject: Music
tutors.title: Music Tutor – Patrick Doyle
tutors.bio: Patrick Doyle is a professional musician and Leaving Certificate Music tutor with a strong background in performance and composition. His lessons focus on developing listening skills, understanding set works, and improving practical performance. Patrick’s friendly, encouraging approach helps students feel confident in both theory and practice.

tutors.name: Daniel Chen
tutors.subject: Computer Science
tutors.title: Computer Science Tutor – Daniel Chen
tutors.bio: Daniel Chen is a software engineer who teaches Computer Science with a focus on problem‑solving and real‑world applications. His lessons cover algorithms, programming fundamentals, and computational thinking in a clear, accessible way. Daniel helps students understand the logic behind code rather than relying on memorisation.

tutors.name: Fiona McCarthy
tutors.subject: History
tutors.title: History Tutor – Fiona McCarthy
tutors.bio: Fiona McCarthy is an experienced History tutor who specialises in essay structure, document analysis, and research skills. She helps students develop strong arguments and write with clarity and confidence. Fiona’s classes are well‑organised and ideal for students aiming to improve their written expression.
